from build123d import *

# ---- Dimensions from the drawing ----
overall_length = 80.0          # 58.7 + 21.3
body_diameter  = 38.4          # ø38.4
collar_diameter = 45.3         # ø45.3
collar_length  = 21.3          # 21.3
body_length    = overall_length - collar_length   # 58.7
bore_diameter  = 20.0          # central through bore
keyway_width   = 6.0           # keyway slot width
keyway_depth   = 4.0           # keyway slot depth
chamfer_size   = 2.0           # chamfer on collar end rim
fillet_radius  = 2.0           # fillet on plain end rim

# ---- Build the revolved profile ----
with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((0, 0), (0, body_diameter / 2))
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (body_length, body_diameter / 2))
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (body_length, collar_diameter / 2))
            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (overall_length, collar_diameter / 2))
            l5 = Line(l4 @ 1, (overall_length, 0))
            l6 = Line(l5 @ 1, (0, 0))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.X)

solid_body = p.part

# ---- Central through bore ----
bore = Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(bore_diameter / 2, overall_length)
solid_body = solid_body - bore

# ---- Keyway slot on collar face ----
keyway = Pos(overall_length - keyway_depth / 2, 0, 0) * Box(keyway_depth, keyway_width, keyway_depth)
solid_body = solid_body - keyway

# ---- Chamfer on collar end rim ----
collar_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.X)[-1]
solid_body = chamfer(collar_face.edges(), chamfer_size)

# ---- Fillet on plain end rim ----
plain_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.X)[0]
solid_body = fillet(plain_face.edges(), fillet_radius)

part = solid_body
part.name = "revolved_shaft_with_keyway"
export_step(part, "output.step")

body_diameter = 38.4
body_length = 58.7
shoulder_diameter = 45.3
shoulder_length = 21.3
chamfer_size = 4.0
fillet_radius = 2.0

junction_edges = [e for e in result.edges() if abs(e.center().X - body_length) < 1.0]
result = fillet(junction_edges, fillet_radius)

# Chamfer at shoulder end
end_edges = [e for e in result.edges() if abs(e.center().X - (body_length + shoulder_length)) < 1.0]
result = chamfer(end_edges, chamfer_size)

part = result
part.name = "stepped_shaft"
export_step(part, "output.step")

    pts = []

    for i in range(2 * points):

        pts.append((r * math.cos(angle), r * math.sin(angle)))

def star_profile_points(outer, inner, points):
    pts = []
    angle_step = math.pi / points
    for i in range(2 * points):

from build123d import *

# Dimensions
# The plate spans the rectangle (-40,-20) to (40,20)
# Top profile: flat back edge, then arc from back wall top
#    through the crown arc to the right front face

plate_width = 80.0        # overall length
plate_depth = 40.0        # base plate height (bottom + front)
plate_thickness = 6.0
crown_height = 20.0       # total extra profile above plate
hole_diameter = 25.0
fillet_radius = 3.0

w = plate_width / 2.0        # 40
d = plate_depth / 2.0        # 20
top_total = d + crown_height # 60 total height

    with BuildSketch() as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            Line((-w, -d), (w, -d))              # bottom
            Line((w, -d), (w, d))                # right front
            Line((w, d), (0, top_total))          # arc top
            Line((0, top_total), (-w, d))         # arc top
            Line((-w, d), (-w, -d))               # left back wall
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=plate_thickness)
    # fillet outer edges parallel to Z axis
    fillet(p.part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z), fillet_radius)

    p.part = p.part - Pos(0, top_total - 20, plate_thickness / 2) * Cylinder(
        hole_diameter / 2, plate_thickness * 2
    )

from build123d import *

overall_length = 80.0          # axial length of the body
small_dia      = 23.2          # small-end diameter  -> r = 11.6
large_dia      = 36.6          # large-end diameter  -> r = 18.3
flange_thk     = 1.3           # flange thickness
flange_dia     = 25.0          # flange outside diameter (qualitative)
hole_dia       = 5.0           # through hole diameter (qualitative)
chamfer_size   = 0.5           # chamfer on flange edges (qualitative)

small_r = small_dia / 2.0
large_r = large_dia / 2.0
flange_r = flange_dia / 2.0

# ---- Revolved body (profile in the YZ plane) ----
with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.YZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((0, 0), (0, small_r))                 # small-end face
            arc = ThreePointArc(l1 @ 1,
                                (overall_length * 0.45, small_r * 0.85),
                                (overall_length * 0.70, large_r * 0.95))
            l2 = Line(arc @ 1, (overall_length, large_r))   # large-end face
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (0, 0))                       # close on axis
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Y)

solid_body = p.part

# ---- Flange disc at the small end ----
flange = Pos(0, flange_thk / 2.0, 0) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(flange_r, flange_thk)

result = chamfer(flange_edges, chamfer_size)

part.name = "revolved_body_with_flange"

from build123d import *

# ---- overall envelope ----
overall_length = 80.0          # X

overall_height = 72.0          # Z

# ---- base foot ----
foot_thickness = 18.3          # Z thickness of the foot
foot_fillet    = 5.7           # R on the four long foot edges

# ---- stem (U channel) ----
stem_width     = 30.0          # X width of the stem
stem_height    = overall_height - foot_thickness   # 53.7
wall_thickness = 9.1           # each side wall
inner_gap      = stem_width - 2 * wall_thickness   # 11.8
stem_fillet    = 9.1           # R on the two outer stem edges

# ---- holes ----
mount_hole_dia = 9.1           # 2x, through the foot along Y
mount_hole_x   = [11.4, 68.6]  # from the end face
stem_hole_dia  = 6.9           # 1x, through the stem along Y
stem_hole_z    = 60.6          # from the bottom face

# ================= base foot =================
foot = Box(overall_length, foot_thickness, foot_thickness)
foot = fillet(foot.edges().filter_by(Axis.Y), foot_fillet)

# ================= stem (U channel) =================

stem = fillet(stem.edges().filter_by(Axis.X), stem_fillet)

inner_cut = Pos(0, 0, foot_thickness/2 + stem_height/2) * Box(stem_width, inner_gap, stem_height)
stem = stem - inner_cut

part = foot + stem

# ================= holes =================

    px = x - overall_length/2
    part = part - Pos(px, 0, 0) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(mount_hole_dia/2, overall_width + 10)

from build123d import *

plate_length = 80.0
plate_width = 60.0
plate_thickness = 11.0
corner_radius = 10.0
hole_diameter = 10.0
hole_offset = 10.0
rib_width = 12.0
rib_height = 6.0
rib_thickness = 3.0

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch() as s:
        RectangleRounded(plate_length, plate_width, corner_radius)
    extrude(amount=plate_thickness)

solid_body = p.part

rib = Pos(0, 0, plate_thickness/2 + rib_thickness/2) * Box(rib_width, rib_height, rib_thickness)
solid_body = solid_body + rib

hole_positions = [
    (-plate_length/2 + hole_offset, -plate_width/2 + hole_offset),
    ( plate_length/2 - hole_offset, -plate_width/2 + hole_offset),
    (-plate_length/2 + hole_offset,  plate_width/2 - hole_offset),
    ( plate_length/2 - hole_offset,  plate_width/2 - hole_offset),
]

for x, y in hole_positions:
    solid_body = solid_body - Pos(x, y, 0) * Cylinder(hole_diameter/2, plate_thickness + rib_thickness + 20)

part = solid_body
part.name = "plate_with_rib_and_holes"
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

outer_diameter = 32.0
outer_radius = outer_diameter / 2.0
total_length = 80.0
shoulder_length = 16.0
shoulder_start = 21.3
shoulder_diameter = 42.7
shoulder_radius = shoulder_diameter / 2.0
hole_diameter = 8.1
hole_offset = 64.0
pocket_width = 10.7
pocket_height = 8.1
pocket_depth = 10.7
hex_flat_distance = 26.7
hex_depth = 5.0

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            Polyline((0, 0), (0, outer_radius), (shoulder_start, outer_radius),
                     (shoulder_start, shoulder_radius),
                     (shoulder_start + shoulder_length, shoulder_radius),
                     (shoulder_start + shoulder_length, outer_radius),
                     (total_length, outer_radius), (total_length, 0), close=True)
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.X)

from build123d import *
import math

# ---- Printed dimensions ----
outer_dia      = 58.7        # ø58.7 outside diameter
outer_radius   = outer_dia / 2.0
length         = 80.0        # overall length (sum of printed axial stations)
bore_dia       = 14.7        # ⌀14.7 through bore
step_dia       = 28.0        # ⌀28 counterbore from base end
step_len       = 40.0        # counterbore depth
keyway_width   = 6.0         # keyway slot width
keyway_depth   = 12.0        # keyway slot depth
hole_dia       = 10.7        # 2× ⌀10.7 cross holes
hole_z1        = 18.7        # first hole station
hole_z2        = 61.3        # second hole station
csk_angle      = 82.0        # countersink angle
csk_depth      = 3.0         # countersink depth

# ---- Base cylinder ----
solid = Cylinder(outer_radius, length)

# ---- Stepped bore ----
solid = solid - Cylinder(bore_dia / 2, length)
solid = solid - Pos(0, 0, -length / 2 + step_len / 2) * Cylinder(step_dia / 2, step_len)

# ---- Keyway slot (full length) ----
solid = solid - Pos(0, keyway_depth / 2, 0) * Box(keyway_width, keyway_depth, length)

# ---- Countersunk cross holes ----
csk_r = hole_dia / 2 + csk_depth * math.tan(math.radians(csk_angle / 2))
hole_tool = Rot(0, 90, 0) * (Cylinder(hole_dia / 2, length) + Cone(csk_r, hole_dia / 2, csk_depth))

for z in (hole_z1 - length / 2, hole_z2 - length / 2):
    solid = solid - Pos(0, outer_radius - csk_depth, z) * hole_tool

part = solid
part.name = "stepped_bore_cylinder_with_keyway"
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *
import math

# ---- Dimensions from the drawing ----
outer_radius = 38.3          # overall lobe envelope (76.6 across the lobes)
root_radius = 26.15          # root of the lobes
hub_radius = 21.8            # hub / bore radius (ø43.6 outside, ø31.5 bore)
thickness = 7.0              # axial thickness of the part

bore_radius = hub_radius * 0.72       # ø31.5 through bore
hole_diameter = 3.5                  # 9× ø3.5 blind holes
hole_depth = 1.7
hole_circle_radius = hub_radius - 1.0 # holes sit just inside the hub rim
chamfer_size = 0.5                   # edges parallel to the axis

# ---- Five-lobed outer profile (polar spline) ----
def polar_point(r, theta):
    return (r * math.cos(theta), r * math.sin(theta))

# alternating crest / root control points around the five lobes
profile_pts = []
for i in range(10):
    angle = math.radians(i * 36.0)
    r = outer_radius if i % 2 == 0 else root_radius
    profile_pts.append(polar_point(r, angle))

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            Spline(*profile_pts, profile_pts[0])   # closed five-lobed outline
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=thickness)

solid_body = p.part

# ---- Central through bore ----
solid_body = solid_body - Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(bore_radius, thickness * 2)

# ---- Nine blind holes on the hub face ----
for i in range(9):
    angle = math.radians(i * 360.0 / 9)
    px = hole_circle_radius * math.cos(angle)
    pz = hole_circle_radius * math.sin(angle)
    hole = Pos(px, thickness - hole_depth / 2, pz) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(hole_diameter / 2, hole_depth)
    solid_body = solid_body - hole

# ---- Chamfer edges parallel to the axis ----
solid_body = chamfer(solid_body.edges().filter_by(Axis.Y), chamfer_size)

part = solid_body
part.name = "five_lobe_hub"
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *
import math

outer_diameter = 52.3
inner_diameter = 31.5
thickness = 7.0
petal_count = 5
petal_radius = 12.0
hole_diameter = 3.5
hole_count = 9
hole_circle_radius = (inner_diameter/2) + 6.0
chamfer_size = 0.5

base = Cylinder(outer_diameter/2, thickness)

petal = Pos(0, outer_diameter/2 + petal_radius/2, 0) * Cylinder(petal_radius, thickness)

flange = base
for i in range(petal_count):
    angle = i * 360.0 / petal_count
    flange = flange + Rot(0, angle, 0) * petal

flange = flange - Cylinder(inner_diameter/2, thickness)

for i in range(hole_count):
    angle = i * 360.0 / hole_count
    px = hole_circle_radius * math.cos(math.radians(angle))

    flange = flange - Pos(px, thickness/2, pz) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(hole_diameter/2, thickness)

vertical_edges = flange.edges().filter_by(Axis.Y)
flange = chamfer(vertical_edges, chamfer_size)

part = flange
part.name = "flange_with_petals"
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *
import math

hub_outer_radius = 26.15
hub_inner_radius = 15.75
hub_thickness = 7.0
petal_length = 12.0
petal_width = 8.0
num_petals = 5
hole_diameter = 3.5
hole_depth = 1.7
hole_count = 9

hub = Cylinder(hub_outer_radius, hub_thickness) - Cylinder(hub_inner_radius, hub_thickness)

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((hub_outer_radius, -hub_thickness/2), (hub_outer_radius + petal_length, -hub_thickness/2))
            arc = ThreePointArc(l1@1, (hub_outer_radius + petal_length + petal_width/2, 0), (hub_outer_radius + petal_length, hub_thickness/2))
            l2 = Line(arc@1, (hub_outer_radius, hub_thickness/2))
            l3 = Line(l2@1, l1@0)
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Y)
petal = p.part

impeller = hub
for i in range(num_petals):
    angle = i * 360.0 / num_petals
    impeller = impeller + Rot(0, angle, 0) * petal

hole_r = hole_diameter / 2
hole_pos_r = hub_outer_radius - hole_depth / 2
for i in range(hole_count):
    theta = math.radians(i * 360.0 / hole_count)
    x = hole_pos_r * math.cos(theta)
    z = hole_pos_r * math.sin(theta)
    impeller = impeller - Pos(x, hub_thickness/2 - hole_depth/2, z) * Cylinder(hole_r, hole_depth)

part = impeller
part.name = "impeller"
export_step(part, "output.step")

    py = hole_radius * math.sin(rad)

    pts = []

        t = theta + 2 * math.pi * i / num_pts

from build123d import *
import math

# ---- overall envelope ----
total_length = 79.9          # Z
total_width  = 19.2          # X
thickness    = 5.8           # Y

# ---- central web ----
web_width    = 5.8           # X
web_length   = 33.0          # Z  (33.0 -> 66.9)

# ---- diagonal arms ----
arm_width    = 5.2           # X
arm_length   = 23.5          # Z  (0 -> 23.5 and 56.4 -> 79.9)

# ---- junction holes (through the web, along X) ----
hole_dia_top = 1.8           # at Z = 47.0
hole_dia_bot = 1.7           # at Z = 33.0

# ---- arm-end holes (through the arms, along Y) ----
arm_hole_dia = 6.7           # at Z = 3.2 and Z = 76.7

# ---- arm pockets (through the arms, along Y) ----
pocket_w     = 4.5           # X
pocket_l     = 12.0          # Z

# ---- fillets ----
fillet_arm_end = 5.2         # 2x  outer arm-end corners
fillet_web_junc = 2.9        # 4x  arm-to-web junction corners
fillet_small   = 0.6         # 16x remaining sharp edges

# =====================================================================
#  Profile in the X-Z plane, extruded to the 5.8 thickness (Y)
# =====================================================================
with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((0, 0), (arm_width, 0))
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (arm_width, arm_length))
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (web_width, arm_length))
            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (web_width, arm_length + web_length))
            l5 = Line(l4 @ 1, (arm_width, arm_length + web_length))
            l6 = Line(l5 @ 1, (arm_width, total_length))
            l7 = Line(l6 @ 1, (0, total_length))
            l8 = Line(l7 @ 1, (0, 0))
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=thickness)

solid_body = p.part

# =====================================================================
#  Fillets on the profile edges (parallel to Y)
# =====================================================================
z_edges = solid_body.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)

arm_end_edges   = [e for e in z_edges if e.center().Z < 0.1 or e.center().Z > total_length - 0.1]
web_junc_edges  = [e for e in z_edges if abs(e.center().Z - arm_length) < 0.1 or abs(e.center().Z - (arm_length + web_length)) < 0.1]
other_edges     = [e for e in z_edges if e not in arm_end_edges and e not in web_junc_edges]

solid_body = fillet(arm_end_edges, fillet_arm_end)
solid_body = fillet(web_junc_edges, fillet_web_junc)
solid_body = fillet(other_edges, fillet_small)

# =====================================================================
#  Junction holes through the web (axis along X)
# =====================================================================
hole_r_top = hole_dia_top / 2
hole_r_bot = hole_dia_bot / 2

solid_body = solid_body - Pos(total_width/2, thickness/2, arm_length + web_length/2) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(hole_r_top, total_width + 2)
solid_body = solid_body - Pos(total_width/2, thickness/2, arm_length) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(hole_r_bot, total_width + 2)

# =====================================================================
#  Arm-end holes through the arms (axis along Y)
# =====================================================================
arm_hole_r = arm_hole_dia / 2

solid_body = solid_body - Pos(arm_width/2, thickness/2, arm_length * 0.136) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(arm_hole_r, thickness + 2)
solid_body = solid_body - Pos(arm_width/2, thickness/2, total_length - arm_length * 0.136) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(arm_hole_r, thickness + 2)

# =====================================================================
#  Arm pockets through the arms (axis along Y)
# =====================================================================
pocket_z1 = arm_length * 0.5
pocket_z2 = total_length - arm_length * 0.5

solid_body = solid_body - Pos(arm_width/2, thickness/2, pocket_z1) * Box(pocket_w, thickness + 2, pocket_l)
solid_body = solid_body - Pos(arm_width/2, thickness/2, pocket_z2) * Box(pocket_w, thickness + 2, pocket_l)

part = solid_body
part.name = "Z_spacer"
export_step(part, "output.step")

# ---- Overall envelope (from drawing) ----
overall_length = 80.0
overall_width = 38.5
overall_height = 29.6

# ---- Main rectangular body ----
body_length = 64.0          # 80 - 16 (boss projection)
body_width = 25.0           # 38.5 - 13.5 (boss projection)
body_height = overall_height

# ---- Fillet radii ----
corner_fillet = 4.4         # 4x R4.4 vertical edges

# ---- Bosses ----
boss_diameter = 20.7        # ø20.7
boss_length = 12.6          # projection length
small_boss_diameter = 7.4   # ø7.4
small_boss_length = 3.7     # projection length

# ---- Holes ----
through_hole_diameter = 16.3        # ⌀16.3
small_hole_diameter = 3.0           # ⌀3.0

# ---- Locations ----
x_boss_center = body_length / 2 + boss_length / 2
y_boss_center = body_width / 2 + boss_length / 2
small_boss_center = -body_length / 2 - small_boss_length / 2
hole_x_center = -body_length / 2 + 23.0   # 23.0 from -X end
hole_y_center = 0.0                       # 12.6 from -Y side

# ---- Build ----
result = Box(body_length, body_width, body_height)
result = fillet(result.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z), corner_fillet)

# +X boss
result = result + Pos(x_boss_center, 0, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(boss_diameter / 2, boss_length)

# +Y boss
result = result + Pos(0, y_boss_center, 0) * Rot(-90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(boss_diameter / 2, boss_length)

# -X small boss
result = result + Pos(small_boss_center, 0, body_height / 2 - small_boss_diameter / 2) * Cylinder(small_boss_diameter / 2, small_boss_length)

part = result

from build123d import *
import math

outer_diameter = 80.0
inner_diameter = 14.5
length = 34.2
slot_width = 5.0
slot_length = 30.0
slot_count = 10
slot_center_radius = (inner_diameter/2) + (slot_length/2)

solid_body = Cylinder(outer_diameter/2, length)
solid_body = solid_body - Cylinder(inner_diameter/2, length)

for i in range(slot_count):
    angle = math.radians(i * 360.0 / slot_count)
    px = slot_center_radius * math.cos(angle)
    py = slot_center_radius * math.sin(angle)
    slot = Pos(px, py, 0) * Rot(0, 0, math.degrees(angle)) * Box(slot_length, slot_width, length)
    solid_body = solid_body - slot

part = solid_body
part.name = "slotted_cylinder"
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *
import math

plate_width = 80.0
plate_height = 70.0
plate_thickness = 6.0
rib_width = 30.0
rib_height = 40.0
rib_depth = 8.0
rib_offset_x = 10.0
rib_offset_y = 15.0
hole_diameter = 5.5
hole_spacing = 20.0
chamfer_angle_deg = 13.0
chamfer_distance = plate_thickness * math.tan(math.radians(chamfer_angle_deg))

base = Box(plate_width, plate_thickness, plate_height)
front_face = base.faces().sort_by(Axis.Y)[0]
base = chamfer(front_face.edges(), chamfer_distance)

rib_center_x = -plate_width/2 + rib_offset_x + rib_width/2
rib_center_z = -plate_height/2 + rib_offset_y + rib_height/2
rib = Pos(rib_center_x, plate_thickness/2 + rib_depth/2, rib_center_z) * Box(rib_width, rib_depth, rib_height)

corner_rib = Box(6.0, rib_depth, 6.0)
corner_positions = [
    (-plate_width/2 + 10.0, -plate_height/2 + 10.0),
    ( plate_width/2 - 10.0, -plate_height/2 + 10.0),
    (-plate_width/2 + 10.0,  plate_height/2 - 10.0),
    ( plate_width/2 - 10.0,  plate_height/2 - 10.0),
]
corner_ribs = Compound([
    Pos(x, plate_thickness/2 + rib_depth/2, z) * corner_rib
    for x, z in corner_positions
])

result = base + rib + corner_ribs

hole_r = hole_diameter / 2
hole_cyl = Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(hole_r, 30.0)
for dz in [-hole_spacing/2, hole_spacing/2]:
    result = result - Pos(rib_center_x, 0, rib_center_z + dz) * hole_cyl

part = result
part.name = "WallMountBracket"
export_step(part, "output.step")

    (step_end,   overall_height),

set_screw_depth = 7.7

from build123d import *

shaft_length = 80.0
shaft_diameter = 8.3
head_length = 15.0
head_diameter = 16.6
slot_width = 4.0
slot_depth = 6.0
chamfer_size = 0.5
hole_diameter = 2.8

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((0, 0), (shaft_diameter / 2, 0))
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (shaft_diameter / 2, shaft_length - head_length))
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (head_diameter / 2, shaft_length - head_length))
            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (head_diameter / 2, shaft_length))
            l5 = Line(l4 @ 1, (0, shaft_length))
            l6 = Line(l5 @ 1, (0, 0))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Y)

solid_body = p.part

# Hole at shaft end (bottom face, centered on axis)
solid_body = solid_body - Cylinder(hole_diameter / 2, shaft_length)

# Slot cut through head
slot_box = Pos(0, shaft_length - head_length / 2, 0) * Box(head_diameter, head_length, slot_width)
solid_body = solid_body - slot_box

# Chamfer edges at shoulder transition
shoulder_edges = [e for e in solid_body.edges() if abs(e.center().Y - (shaft_length - head_length)) < 1.0]
solid_body = chamfer(shoulder_edges, chamfer_size)

part = solid_body
part.name = "shaft_with_head"
export_step(part, "output.step")

    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((0, 0), (flange_diameter / 2, 0))

            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (body_diameter / 2, flange_thickness))
            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (body_diameter / 2, flange_thickness + body_height))

solid_body = p.part

solid_body = fillet(top_edges, fillet_radius)

total_height = flange_thickness + body_height
solid_body = solid_body - Pos(0, 0, total_height / 2) * Cylinder(bore_diameter / 2, total_height + 10)

    py = hole_circle_radius * math.sin(angle)
    solid_body = solid_body - Pos(px, py, total_height / 2) * Cylinder(hole_diameter / 2, total_height + 10)

import math

# ---- dimensions from the drawing ----
flange_dia        = 80.0      # ø80
flange_thk        = 13.8
body_dia          = 49.7      # ø49.7
body_h            = 44.1
total_h           = flange_thk + body_h   # 60.7

bore_dia          = 27.6      # 1× ⌀27.6
hole_dia          = 6.9       # 6× ⌀6.9
hole_circle_r     = 36.2      # from printed 72.4

chamfer_sz        = 2.0       # small edge break (not printed)

# ---- revolved profile (XZ) ----
with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            Polyline((0, 0), (flange_dia/2, 0), (flange_dia/2, flange_thk),
                     (body_dia/2, flange_thk), (body_dia/2, total_h),
                     (0, total_h), close=True)
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Z)

solid = p.part

# ---- central bore ----
solid = solid - Pos(0, 0, total_h/2) * Cylinder(bore_dia/2, total_h + 2)

    py = hole_circle_r * math.sin(ang)

from build123d import *
import math

plate_width = 80.0
plate_depth = 80.0
plate_thickness = 10.0
outer_fillet_radius = 10.0
bottom_fillet_radius = 4.0
central_hole_diameter = 7.9
counterbore_diameter = 72.0
counterbore_depth = 5.0
slot_width = 5.0
slot_length = 30.0
slot_count = 6
boss_diameter = 15.9
boss_height = 7.0
boss_offset = 10.0

solid_body = Box(plate_width, plate_depth, plate_thickness)
solid_body = fillet(solid_body.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z), outer_fillet_radius)
bottom_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[0]
solid_body = fillet(bottom_face.edges(), bottom_fillet_radius)

solid_body = solid_body - Cylinder(central_hole_diameter/2, plate_thickness + 1)
solid_body = solid_body - Pos(0, 0, plate_thickness/2 - counterbore_depth/2) * Cylinder(counterbore_diameter/2, counterbore_depth)

slot_radius = (plate_width / 2) - (slot_length / 2)
for i in range(slot_count):
    angle_deg = i * 360.0 / slot_count
    angle_rad = math.radians(angle_deg)
    px = slot_radius * math.cos(angle_rad)
    py = slot_radius * math.sin(angle_rad)
    slot = Pos(px, py, 0) * Rot(0, 0, angle_deg) * Box(slot_length, slot_width, plate_thickness + 1)
    solid_body = solid_body - slot

boss_positions = [
    (plate_width/2 - boss_offset, plate_depth/2 - boss_offset),
    (-plate_width/2 + boss_offset, plate_depth/2 - boss_offset),
    (-plate_width/2 + boss_offset, -plate_depth/2 + boss_offset),
    (plate_width/2 - boss_offset, -plate_depth/2 + boss_offset),
]
for x, y in boss_positions:
    boss = Pos(x, y, plate_thickness/2 + boss_height/2) * Cylinder(boss_diameter/2, boss_height)

hub_length = 25.0              # hub axial length (derived from drawing)
bore_diameter = 22.9           # central through bore

set_screw_offset = 7.4         # set-screw hole centre from datum face
hole_diameter = 6.3            # 8x flange holes
hole_circle_radius = (outer_diameter / 2) - 5.7   # bolt circle

# ---- Build the revolved profile ----
with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((0, 0), (hub_diameter / 2, 0))
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (hub_diameter / 2, set_screw_offset))
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (outer_diameter / 2, set_screw_offset))
            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (outer_diameter / 2, set_screw_offset + flange_thickness))
            l5 = Line(l4 @ 1, (hub_diameter / 2, set_screw_offset + flange_thickness))
            l6 = Line(l5 @ 1, (hub_diameter / 2, hub_length))
            l7 = Line(l6 @ 1, (0, hub_length))
            l8 = Line(l7 @ 1, (0, 0))
        make_face()

solid_body = p.part

solid_body = solid_body - set_screw

import math

# --- Derived dimensions from the drawing ---
# Central bore diameter (1x ⌀21.1) and lobe bore diameter (3x ⌀21.1)
bore_diameter = 21.1
# Lobe outer diameter (ø29.6) -> outer radius
lobe_outer_radius = 29.6 / 2.0
# Wall thickness between bore and outer surface
wall_thickness = lobe_outer_radius - bore_diameter / 2.0
# Plate thickness
plate_thickness = 6.6
# Envelope: 80.0 wide, 73.2 tall
# Lobe centers on a bolt circle of radius R_lobes
# Top lobe center y = 73.2 - lobe_outer_radius = 43.6
# Bottom lobe centers y = - (73.2 - lobe_outer_radius) / 2 = -21.8
# => R_lobes = 29.3
lobe_center_radius = 29.3
# Fillet radius on outer lobe edges (6x R1.9)
fillet_radius = 1.9

# --- Build the solid ---
# Central disc
central = Cylinder(lobe_outer_radius, plate_thickness)

# Three lobes at 120° spacing
lobe = Cylinder(lobe_outer_radius, plate_thickness)
lobe0 = Pos(0, lobe_center_radius, 0) * lobe
lobe120 = Rot(0, 0, 120) * lobe0
lobe240 = Rot(0, 0, 240) * lobe0

# Union all lobes + central
solid_body = central + lobe0 + lobe120 + lobe240

# Fillet all edges (outer lobe edges + bore edges)
solid_body = fillet(solid_body.edges(), fillet_radius)

# Central bore
solid_body = solid_body - Cylinder(bore_diameter / 2, plate_thickness)

# Lobe bores
for angle_deg in (0, 120, 240):
    angle = math.radians(angle_deg)
    px = lobe_center_radius * math.cos(angle)
    py = lobe_center_radius * math.sin(angle)
    solid_body = solid_body - Pos(px, py, 0) * Cylinder(bore_diameter / 2, plate_thickness)

part = solid_body
part.name = "three_lobe_plate"

from build123d import *
import math

# ---- dimensions from the drawing ----
plate_thickness = 6.6          # printed "6.6"
hub_diameter    = 29.6         # printed "ø29.6"
arm_diameter    = 29.6         # printed "ø29.6" (arm lobe)
arm_center_radius = 29.3       # printed "29.3" (hub centre -> arm centre)
central_hole_dia = 21.1        # printed "1× ⌀21.1"
arm_hole_dia     = 21.1        # printed "3× ⌀21.1"
mount_hole_dia   = 4.0         # small mounting holes (size not printed)
mount_hole_radius = 33.0       # hub centre -> mounting-hole centre
fillet_radius    = 1.5         # edge break (size not printed)

hub_radius = hub_diameter / 2.0
arm_radius = arm_diameter / 2.0

# ---- build the three-lobed plate ----
with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch() as s:
        Circle(hub_radius)
        for i in range(3):
            a = math.radians(i * 120.0)
            px = arm_center_radius * math.cos(a)
            py = arm_center_radius * math.sin(a)
            with Locations((px, py)):
                Circle(arm_radius)
    extrude(amount=plate_thickness)

solid_body = p.part
solid_body = fillet(solid_body.edges(), fillet_radius)

# ---- through holes ----
hole_h = plate_thickness * 2.0
solid_body = solid_body - Cylinder(central_hole_dia / 2.0, hole_h)

for i in range(3):
    a = math.radians(i * 120.0)
    px = arm_center_radius * math.cos(a)
    py = arm_center_radius * math.sin(a)
    solid_body = solid_body - Pos(px, py, 0) * Cylinder(arm_hole_dia / 2.0, hole_h)

for i in range(3):
    a = math.radians(i * 120.0)
    px = mount_hole_radius * math.cos(a)
    py = mount_hole_radius * math.sin(a)
    solid_body = solid_body - Pos(px, py, 0) * Cylinder(mount_hole_dia / 2.0, hole_h)

part = solid_body
part.name = "three_arm_plate"
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *
import math

# ---- Dimensions from the drawing ----
overall_height = 58.1          # total part height
hex_height     = 31.7          # height of the hexagonal boss
cyl_height     = overall_height - hex_height   # 26.4  (cylindrical body)

hex_across_flats = 50.3        # hexagon size (across flats)
hex_circumradius = hex_across_flats / math.sqrt(3)   # ~29.04

cyl_radius = 40.0              # cylindrical body radius
slot_width   = 5.0             # radial slot width
slot_depth   = 10.0            # slot depth from outer surface
slot_count   = 12              # evenly spaced slots

chamfer_size = 2.6             # C2.6 bottom-edge chamfer

# ---- Base cylinder ----
cyl = Pos(0, 0, cyl_height / 2) * Cylinder(cyl_radius, cyl_height)

# ---- Radial slots (cut through full cyl height) ----
slot_r = cyl_radius - slot_depth / 2
for i in range(slot_count):
    angle = math.radians(i * 360.0 / slot_count)
    px = slot_r * math.cos(angle)
    py = slot_r * math.sin(angle)
    cyl = cyl - Pos(px, py, cyl_height / 2) * Box(slot_width, slot_depth, cyl_height)

# ---- Hexagonal boss on top ----
with BuildPart() as hp:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(cyl_height)) as sk:
        RegularPolygon(hex_circumradius, 6)
    extrude(amount=hex_height)
hex_boss = hp.part

# ---- Combine ----
part = cyl + hex_boss

# ---- Chamfer bottom outer edge ----
bottom_face = part.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[0]
part = chamfer(bottom_face.edges(), chamfer_size)

part.name = "cylinder_with_slots_and_hex_boss"
export_step(part, "output.step")
